Class C2paReader

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.jc2pa.C2paReader
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class C2paReader extends Object implements Closeable
High-level wrapper around the c2pa WASM reader functions.

Manages the lifetime of the underlying WASM reader handle. Must be closed when no longer needed to release the WASM-side allocation. 

try (C2paReader reader = C2paReader.fromBytes(wasm, "image/jpeg", jpegBytes)) {
    System.out.println(reader.json());
    System.out.println(reader.activeLabel());
}

Mirrors the original WasmReader struct and its #[wasm_bindgen] impl block.

    • fromBytes

      public static C2paReader fromBytes(C2paWasm wasm, String format, byte[] data) throws C2paException
      Create a reader from an asset's raw bytes.

      Mirrors WasmReader::from_blob (sync variant).

      Parameters:
      wasm - Initialised C2paWasm instance.
      format - MIME type or file extension, e.g. "image/jpeg".
      data - Raw asset bytes.
      Returns:
      A new C2paReader; caller must close it.
      Throws:
      C2paException - if the WASM function returns an error.
